title: Measuring Human-AI and AI-AI Teams in Multi-turn Layout Creation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Co-creating layouts such as websites and slides is a useful testbed for evaluating multi-turn instruction following of LLM systems. Since an intended layout's appearance cannot be well expressed in a single turn, the user must wait for the LLM to generate a layout then iteratively refine it with the LLM over multiple turns. We present a small-scale, exploratory (n=6) study of this multi-turn process to compare the differences of human-AI and AI-AI teams on the same layout-generation task. Given a reference wire-frame layout, a participant or a language model 'speaker' issues natural-language instructions to a fixed 'listener' LLM over multiple turns until the speaker is satisfied. Rather than an LLM as the judge, we fit a scoring function over geometric layout features using curated human preference data (n=19). translated_title: 在多轮布局创建中测量人-AI团队与AI-AI团队的差异
translated_abstract: 共同创建网页和幻灯片等布局是评估大语言模型系统多轮指令遵循能力的有效测试平台。由于预期的布局外观无法在单轮对话中充分表达，用户必须等待大语言模型生成布局，然后在多轮对话中对其进行迭代式完善。我们对这一多轮过程进行了一项小规模探索性研究（n=6），以比较人-AI团队与AI-AI团队在同一布局生成任务上的差异。给定一个参考线框图布局，由参与者或语言模型充当"说话者"，通过多轮对话向固定的"倾听者"大语言模型发出自然语言指令，直到说话者满意为止。我们没有采用大语言模型作为评判者，而是利用精心整理的人类偏好数据（n=19）拟合了一个基于几何布局特征的评分函数。我们发现，大语言模型倾向于在第一轮对话中就编码整个布局，而人类平均会通过多轮对话进行迭代完善。
tldr: 该研究通过基于人类偏好数据拟合的几何特征评分函数，比较了人-AI团队与AI-AI团队在多轮布局创建任务中的表现，发现大语言模型倾向于在首轮对话中编码完整布局，而人类则更倾向于多轮迭代完善。
en_tdlr: This exploratory study compares human-AI and AI-AI teams on multi-turn layout creation using a scoring function fitted on geometric layout features from curated human preference data, finding that LLMs tend to encode the entire layout in the first turn while humans iterate over multiple turns.
